header.name: Builder
header.description: A blueprint table and a builder who raises buildings from it, one block every few seconds, paid for from the chest beside the table. Three blueprints to start: a well, a larder and a wall segment. A prototype of the settlements' builder, standing alone so it can be measured before it joins the villages.

modules.description: Builder: the blueprint table, blueprint items, the builder and the structures

settings.text: Hold a blueprint and tap the blueprint table: it shows the building, its size and the materials it needs, and places it from where you stand, toward the east and south, facing the way you face. The chest beside the table pays for it. A builder walks to each spot and puts one block down at a time, from the ground up; taking a building down puts every block back in the chest.
Seconds between one block and the next
settings.name: builder:seconds_per_block

settings.text: Buildings are free: nothing is taken from the chest, and a building raised free returns nothing when it is taken down
settings.name: builder:free_build
